objective: Recuperacion quirurgica Toast Gate4 R2: auditoria SQL exclusivamente metadata canónica de columnas, constraints y FK usando INFORMATION_SCHEMA, con consultas independientes para aislar cualquier fallo. No DDL/DML, no secrets, no pruebas Toast, no Production. Preparar plan de alta sin ejecutar.

queries.name: TOAST_G4_R2_COLUMNS
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_DEFAULT FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION;

queries.name: TOAST_G4_R2_CONSTRAINTS
queries.sql: SELECT tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE,kcu.COLUMN_NAME,kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME=tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND kcu.TABLE_NAME=tc.TABLE_NAME AND kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA=tc.TABLE_SCHEMA WHERE tc.TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND tc.TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') ORDER BY tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME,kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION;

queries.name: TOAST_G4_R2_REFERENCES
queries.sql: SELECT fk.TABLE_NAME,fk.COLUMN_NAME,fk.CONSTRAINT_NAME,pk.TABLE_NAME AS REFERENCED_TABLE,pk.COLUMN_NAME AS REFERENCED_COLUMN FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS rc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE fk ON fk.CONSTRAINT_NAME=rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE pk ON pk.CONSTRAINT_NAME=rc.UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME AND pk.ORDINAL_POSITION=fk.ORDINAL_POSITION WHERE fk.TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND fk.TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') ORDER BY fk.TABLE_NAME,fk.CONSTRAINT_NAME,fk.ORDINAL_POSITION;
